# fct_foreign_exchange_rates

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_foreign_exchange_rates` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Daily foreign exchange rates to USD from other currencies. Includes bid, midpoint, and ask rates. Each row is one currency pair on a single date. Sourced from OANDA, a ForEx rate platform.
